text:
One born in Sushubha Yoga will be wealthy, attached to
women, principled, ever active, fickleminded, luxurious, unrea-

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
sonable or unintelligible and be the head of some monetary
transactions. Ashubha Yoga native will have strong body,x be
leader of his caste, very enthusiastic, able speaker, be helpful to
others, will sacrifice, be dear to all and very famous. One born in
Karthari Yoga will be dispersed to height of angry, grieved, will
hate parents and lack enthusiasm He will be intent on living in
other countries and be subjected to risk by poison, fire and
weapons. These results follow due to malefic participants in the
Yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Benefics in 6th, 7th and 8th from Lagna, free from the aspect
or company of a malefic, cause Lagnadhi Yoga. Malefics should
not be in the 4th house.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The person who has his birth in Lagnadhi Yoga will become
a minister, army chief or a king. He will have many wives, be
humble, will enjoy a long lease of life, be virtuously disposed and
be free from any enemies.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: Notes: See slokas 5 and 6 of this chapter.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should there be planets in the 1st, 7th, 10th and the 4th, and
none in the 12th and tire 8th while the 9th has an occupant in it,
the resulting Yoga is called Parvatha (4^4) Yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Jataka Parijata (ch. 7, slokas 128 and 129) has two
different kinds of Parvatha Yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: 1. Benefics in the angles while the 8th and 12th are free.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: 2. The Lords of Lagna and the 12th in mutual angles and

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: aspected by a friendly planet or planets.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Phala Deepika has a different kind of Parvatha Yoga in ch. 6,
sloka 35: lagna lord in angle or trine and in own house or exalta-
tion house. Sata Manjari Raja Yoga states: the dispositor of lagna
lord should be in own rasi or moola trikona rasi and in angle or
trine to cause this Yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
A Parvatha Yoga native will rule the earth, be virtuous and
modest. He will establish villages, towns and cities. He will have
his fame last till the Yuga (^n) ends.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the planets are with strength and are placed severally, one
of them in another's rasi and one at least be posited in ascendant,
Dhwaja Yoga is produced.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: According to Yavanas all planets in 10th and Lagna
produce Dhwaja Yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
According to Soma jataka, when all planets are in Aries,
Taurus and Pisces Dhwaja Yoga is formed. The results ascribed
are: palanquin, (royal) umbrella and positions. Even a base per-
son gets palanquins; others become king's ministers and those of
royal scion undoubtedly become kings.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Dhwaja Yoga native will acquire wide fame, courage and
wisdom. He will be liked in royal circles and be rich. He will be
fickleminded.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If two strong planets are in two different houses, with one or
two houses in between them, while others are in other houses,
Kundala Yoga results.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: For example a strong Jupiter is in Aries while Saturn
is in Gemini (i.e. Taurus is in between them) or Saturn is in
Cancer (i.e. Taurus and Gemini are in between Aries Jupiter and
Cancer Saturn.) Other planets can be in other houses. Then
Kundala Yoga is formed.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One born in Kundala Yoga, wilt live on other's money, be
easily irritated at the slightest pretext, and will remain satisfied
with little, be versed in literature and arts, shortlived and will
have limited number of children.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: 3m ^ h m i v i < i h m mrTTn Rr^fi yt » ^r~

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
All the planets (i.e. from Sun to Saturn) disposed in one
house cause Gola Yoga; in 2 signs-Yuga-Yoga; in 3 signs-SuIa
Yoga, in 4 signs-Kedara Yoga; in 5 signs-Pasa Yoga; in 6 signs-
Dama Yoga and in 7 signs-Veena Yoga, causing wide fame.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Sula Yoga and Gola Yogas are not Raja Yogas while
the other 4 are auspicious Yogas promising prosperity. These
seven Yogas are caused by seven planets disposed in certain
number of houses. But the houses occupied need not be continu-
ous. For example in Kedara Yoga, the 7 planets can be in any four
rasis. So to say, they can be in Aries, Cancer, Aquarius and Leo.
There is another kind of Yogas formed by group of planets
disposed in continuous signs from Lagna. These are known as
Mallika Yogas. For example, Lagna Mallika Yoga is formed if the
7 planets are in continuous rasis from Lagna. For more informa-

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
tion, refer to Sri Ramanujacharya's Bhavartha Ratnakara,
Vaidyanatha's Jataka Parijatha and Venkatesa Daivajna’s
Sathamanjari Raja Yoga. Of course Bhavartha Ratnakara includes
the nodes also, which however, cannot be practicable, because
the nodes fall mutually in the 7th. And six house involvement
and lesser than that is not possible. Only 7, 8 and 9 houses are
possible.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One born in Veena Yoga will be very learned and have
various kinds of wealth, luxuries etc. at his disposal. He will be
chief among his own men, wise and expert. He will love right
things, arid be very enthusiastic.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
A Dama Yoga native will be happy, kind and devoted to
public welfare (or their work) and a noted scholar. He will be
wise and rich and exhibit valour in wars.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One born in Pasa (W) Yoga, will be burdened with many
expenses, be an expert and dear to all. He will be great intellec-
tual, enthusiastic and be liked in royal circles. He will engage in
activities relating to his house.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native of Kedara Yoga will help his relatives, earn
money through agriculture, be dutiful, sluggish and honoured.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native with Sula Yoga will be intelligent and will have
many means of livelihood. He will be very sick, earn by pur-

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: chases and sales, will have two wives but no child.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: Notes: ^Tclf is interpreted here as livelihood instead of "news".

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One born with Yuga Yoga will be disabled, harsh in speech
and be shameless. He will have many debts, be shortlived and
will have limited relatives.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One born with Gola Yoga will have a short lease of life, be
not wealthy, be defective in some limb, and killer of his own
children. He will have no relations, sons and wife. He will be
always on the move and be hungry and be banished. The results
mentioned do not apply to the 10th, 11th, 1st and 9th houses.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should all the planets (from Sun to Saturn) be angular to
lagna, Mangala Yoga is produced. Should they be (specifically)
confined to the 10th house, Madhya Yoga is produced. If the
planets be in 3rd, 6th, and 12th (disposed in any manner in these
Bhavas), a Yoga called Kleeba is produced. These three kinds of
Yogas are known as Kendra yogas and belong to Yavanas (Greek
astrologers).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Til jflit) f4t4 •4 >c'4I ij [<+iK , *>: I
crhI 1 1 36 II

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Mangala Yoga nahve will be doing auspicious acts for ever.
He will be an able orator. He will have issues, be intelligent and
longlived.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Madhya Yoga native will live in other countries, be troubled
by relatives and timid in nature. He won't have lasting wealth,
will have few issues, and will die through bad ways.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Kleeba Yoga native will be grieved, will live in other coun-
tries, be in the company of mean women and fond of disputes.
He will have no long life and his death will be in a distant
country.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: ii 3m < h hh c rifa ^ it

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should all the planets (from the Sun to Saturn) be in Movable
rasis (i.e. Aries and angles) the resulting Yoga is Rajju. In fixed
rasis (i.e. Taurus and its angles) these produce Musala Yoga.
Lastly in Ubahya rasis (common sign) (i.e. Gemini and its
Kendras) Nala (TO) Yoga is produced by occupation of all the
7 planets.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: In the above 3 kinds of yogas, the Sun, Venus and
Mercury will be in one rasi only. These yogas can be constituted
by the other six planets with reference to the Moon also.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One bom with Rajju Yoga will not be industrious. He will be
poor and will join bad people. He has a medium span of life.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One born in Musala Yoga, will be energetic blesseed with
wife, sons and wealth. He will enjoy all kinds of wealth, be wise
and dear to his own men.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The person who has Nala Yoga, will be intelligent. He will be
disabled and be with few issues. He will be intent upon doing
acts beneficial to others, be rich and will have a medium span of
life.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If all the benefics be in Kendra houses, HRTI (Mala) Yoga is
formed. In a like position malefics cause Sarpa (W'f) Yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: In this context benefics and malefics are not with
reference to rising sign. Only natural disposition is counted here.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native who has Mala Yoga will be learned and wealthy.
Should these benefics confine to the 10th and the 1st only, his
race does not descend.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One bom in Sarpa Yoga will talk too much and will leave his
paternal place. He will be a source of trouble to others, and
derive pleasure thereby. He will be shortlived.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Bhujaga is snake i.e. Sarpa and hence
"Bhujagodbhava' 1 means one bom with the said Sarpa Yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
When all the planets occupy the first six signs, Shatpada
Yoga is produced. The person born with this Yoga, will com-

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: mand leadership over money and gather the essence (of Sastras).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If these planets be in 1st, 5th and 4th, Varaha Yoga follows.
Such a native will command land, wealth, happiness and wis-
dom.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
All the planets in the 2nd, the 3rd and the 4th cause Kantaka
Yoga. One bom in such Yoga will be wealthy and learned but
shortlived. He will have no issue.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Hala Yoga is produced when the Lagna and 12th hold all the
planets. Should they be in lagna, the 5th and the 9th, Sringataka
Yoga is formed and when these be in Lagna and its opposite
house, Sakta Yoga is formed. Vihaga Yoga is produced when
such planets are all in the 4th and 10th houses.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: s ppc<jt! m-. n so n

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Hala Yoga native will be disposed to anger, very poor, dis-
abled and shortlived. He will be a farmer. Sringataka Yoga native
will have wind as a predominant temperament and be angry. He
will be a great man but poor.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: cl~4 ^ tkFcR i jj | i 1151 II

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: One born in Sakata Yoga will be moving like a cart. He will

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
be bereaved by death of his son and wife. He will oe of wicked
mentality, idle and have defective sight.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One born in Vihaga Yoga will be happy and engaged in
amassing wealth in several ways. His valour will be
unsurpassed. He will have many places to reside and he will be
loved when in others' places.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
When all the planets occupy the 9th, the 1 1th, the 1st and the
4th houses, Sankha Yoga is produced. Should they occupy the six
odd houses, (i.e. Aries, Gemini, Leo etc.) Chakra Yoga is formed.
So have the sages mentioned. Should all the planets be ranged
from the 2nd house in six Rasis, intervened by planetless houses,
Samudra Yoga is formed. (That is planets should be in the 2nd,
4th, 6th, 8th, 10th and 12th with other houses having no planets
will cause Samudra Yoga,) When these planets in such condition
have two blank houses. Indraft) Yoga is formed, (see p. 242)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: In Samudra Yoga, there is one blank rasi between the
planets on either side. In Indra Yoga, there are two blank rasis on
either side of the planets. Both the yogas involve the second
house.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The effects of Sankha Yoga are: the native will be a repository
of virtues, brave and versed. The one who has Chakra Yoga will
be a repository of good qualities, king and will attain the throne
of a large kingdom. One bom in Samudra Yoga will be blind
right from birth, will be dear to all, miser, lord of money and will
have issues. One bom in Indra Yoga (or Mahendra Yoga as called
in this sloka) will be famous and will have many titles. He will be
wealthy and also a superior man.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: There are four lines in this sloka, each line devoting to
Sankha, Chakra, Samudra and Indra (Mahendra) yogas, respec-
tively. However, there is no mention of Samudra Yoga in the 3rd
line. The translation has been made suitably to fill the void and
with sense.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Thus ends the 19th Cahpter entitled "Chandra and Nabhasa
Yogas" in Horasara of Prithuyasas, son of Varaha Mihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon or Lagna be in Vargothama Navamsa and
be in aspect to four or more planets, the person bom will be a
king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: See Phala Deepika, ch. 7, sloka 5. Lagna when in
Vargothama, if aspected by 4 planets, other than the Moon, will
make one king even though he may be of any order. However,
Brihat Jataka (ch. XI, sloka 3) is silent on the Moon as far as
Lagna is concerned. Jataka Parijata (Rajayogadhyaya, sloka 5)
gives a similar view as in Phala Deepika.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Venus be in Aswini nakshatra identical with Lagna and is
aspected by all other planets, one will become a king conquering
the entire band of his enemies.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The sloka requires the Lagna also to be is Aswini (and
not the whole of Aries) along with Venus therein. The Lagna and
Venus can be in any of the 4th quarters of Aswini, i.e. they can
be in Aries Navamsa, or the next three Navamsas. The Sun and
Mercury cannot aspect Venus as laid down by the sloka. How-
ever, Phala Deepika. ch. 7, sloka 8, does not use the word "all"
thereby eliminating the need for the Sun and Mercury to be in
the picture. Jataka Parijatha ch. 7, sloka 6) of course uses

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
which condition cannot be fulfilled. There is no refer-
ence to such Yoga in Saravali, which, however, refers to Venus in
Lagna in Aswini, Krithika, Pushyami, Swathi or Revati making
one a reputed ruler. (See ch. 35, sloka 149).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
This view is accepted by Keeranur Nataraja’s Jatakalankara.
In other words, as per Jatakalankara and Saravali, Venus simply
in Aswini as Lagna is enough; Horasara and Jataka Parijata have
the same condition that cannot be fulfilled.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Venus be in the 2nd house, not being in the company
of a debilated or inimical planet, and join the Lagna lord with
strength the native rules over the earth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: According to Jataka Parijata the lagna lord need only
be strong and he need not be in the 2nd. (See ch. 7, sloka 7). Phala
Deepika, ch. 7, sloka 7 gives the same view as given by the sloka
under comment.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should three or more planets be in own or exaltation houses,
without being in fall in Navamsa, one will become a king who
will win the band of his enemies.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Dundhiraja's Jatakabharanam in sloka 4 of
Rajayogadhyaya says that if four planets be exalted in a horo-
scope the native becomes such a king, whose band of elephants
will form a "bridge" themselves so that the armymen cross the
river. It further adds that 5 planets in exaltation make even an
ordinary person a king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If three or more planets be in their own or exlatation houses,
avoiding debilitation Navamsas, and at the same time being one
of them in the lagna, the person becomes a king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Refer to Jataka Parijata, ch. 6, s. 36 in which it is
clearly stated that a planet in exaltation rasi but in debilitation
Navamsa gives bad results and that too, quickly. In contrast, if it
is in neecha rasi and uchcha amsa, it only proves auspicious.
Thus, we should note the efficacy of Navamsa position of a
planet vis-a-vis its rasi position.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon and Mars be in lagna, 9th or 10th, while the
Sun and Jupiter are strong, the nat ive will become a king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Mars alone in the 10th is capable of conferring a
Rajayoga, see the saying iUirnfi 77 did: and if the

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
entire combination is present as per tire sloka under comment, it
is still superior.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Jupiter aspect Mercury, the native will become a king
whose orders will faithfully be obeyed by other kings.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Similarly Mercury's aspect on Jupiter also brings out
a Raja Yoga. (Phala Deepika.) But if Mercury (from 8th) aspects
Jupiter in the 2nd according to Jataka Jambunadeeyam one be-
comes penniless spending away his earnings.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon, in the case of a night birth, occupy a
friendly navamsa, and be a spec ted by Venus, one will become
king, other planets aspects on such Moon will not make him a
king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The Navamsa position should be noted and aspect
should be counted only in the rasi chart and not in navamsa
chart or any such other charts. For aspect is formed only by
longitudinal distance between planets. For day birth, please see
next sloka.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon, in the case of a day birth, be in her own
navamsa or in exaltation navamsa, or in a friendly navamsa or be
aspected by Jupiter, the person will become a king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: There is difference in application between the previ-
ous verse and this one. In the first case, Venus should aspect the
Moon posited in a friendly amsa and in the second case Jupiter's
aspect on Moon can itself constitute a Yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Leo rises, at sunrise, avoiding a navamsa of Venus, when
Mercury is in Kanya, even a mean person will become a king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Firstly, the Sun will be in iagna itself at the time of
Sunrise. In Leo, the 2nd and 7th navamsa belong to Venus, which
should not be in lagna. Mercury should be exalted in the 2nd,
Dhanasthana to complete the Yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: The same Yoga is found in sloka 43, ch. 7 of Jataka Parijata.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Venus be in Pisces in rasi and navamsa, while the
sign Pisces ascends in rasi and navamsa, one will become a king.
Mars and Saturn in the ascendant or 5th or 10th will give similar
results.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Jataka Parijata (ch. 7. sloka 44) has a Yoga of Mars and
Saturn joining in lagna, 5th or 10th. But an additional condition is
that full Moon should be simultaneously in a house of Jupiter. In
our view, the Yogas of Horasara and Jataka Parijata are both
good Rajayogas.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The Full Moon in the 9th causes the birth of a king. Pushkala
Yoga is formed if the lord of the Moon sign is in a friendly angle
along with lagna lord and aspects lagna. The dispositor of the
Moon should be strong in this Yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Phala Deepika has Pushkala Yoga in ch. 6. The only
difference there is that a strong benefic should aspect lagna as
against Horasara's condition of Moon's dispositor aspecting
lagna. Both kinds of Yogas can be safely inferred as Raja Yogas
ignoring the conditional variance.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Pushkala Yoga native will, as a rule, lord over the earth.
Should he be of royal scion, he will wear the regal crown and
adore a regal umbrella.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon sign lord be in an angle with strength, the
native will have an empire. If the said lord be in aspect to or be
in conjunction with a friendly planet, even a low bom person will
become a king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: See sloka 45, ch. 7 of Jataka Parijata. If the lord of
lagna is with strength and be angular, one becomes a king. Ac-
cording to Saravali, one bom with the ascendant lord in angle
and aspected by friendly planet while a benefic is in lagna be-
comes a king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Lagna Lord be in his exaltation sign, aspecting
Moon, one will become a king to command a wide fleet of
elephants, horses and such other forces, destroy his enemies in
total and have at his disposal a great paraphemelia.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: See Jataka Parijata, (sloka 46 ch. 7) where a similar
Yoga is noted. However, “ci'-iiPnfa” of the sloka of Horasara is
replaced by "*i'+iifW in Jataka Parijata. Pt. Gopesh Kumar Ojha in

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: his translation has interpreted as | a gna lord which is

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
not incorrect. However, in Horasara the author has specifically
chosen lagna lord for Lagnadhipathi and Janmadhipathi
as Moon sign lord. To us, the view of Prithuyasas is more
acceptable.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
In sloka 12 of this chapter "Janmadhipa" and "Lagnadhipa"
are shown distinctly to mean "Moon sign lord” and "Lagna lord".
"Janmesa" and "Lagnapati” are similarly used in Phala Deepika,
ch. 6, sloka 19.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Saravali, ch. 35, sloka 109 (my translation in English, has
exactly the same sloka of Horasara under comment.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon, full of her digits, be in angle, other than the
lagna (i.e. in the 4th, 7th or 10th) and be aspected by Jupiter and
Venus, the native lords over the earth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Jataka Parijata ( 7/47 ) has similar Rajayoga.
But Saravali and Phala Deepika do not involve Jupiter and
Venus.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the lord of the ascendant is exalted, at the same time not
being in inimical house or debilitation amsa, and when lonely
placed in an angle, will make one king of kings.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: There are 5 conditions involved in this Sarva Bhauma
Yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: 1. Lord of lagna should be uchcha.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: 2. He should not be in neecha amsa.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: 3. He should not be in amsa of enemy

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: 5. He should be in an angle.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: See Jataka Parijatha, ch. 7, sloka 47 for a similar view.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars be in lagna, identical with Aries, Leo or
Sagittarius, and in aspect to a friendly planet, one will become
a king, who with the strength of his own hands destroys
the enemies.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The aspecting planet, if be Jupiter the Yoga will have
more effect.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The view of Prithuyasas can be found in sloka 12, ch. 7 of
) a taka Parijata.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars be in the 10th in the constellation of Aswini,
Anuradha or Dhanishta or if the Sun is in Lagna other than Libra,
the native will become a king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: For Mars to be in the 10th in Aswini, the Lagna
should be Cancer; for Anuradha— the Lagna should be Aquarius
and for Dhanishta the Lagna should be Aries. For all these 3 signs
Mars is an unsullied Yogakaraka and his position in 10th tor
these lagnas is a great blessing. Also see notes under sloka 6 of
this chapter.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
For Cancer lagna Mars is the 10th in Aries in Aswini, for
Aquarius Lagna in 10th in Scorpio in Anuradha and for Aries
Lagna in 10th in Capricorn in Dhanishta, can prove highly auspi-
cious. Dhanishta falls in Aquarius also. Hence for Taurus, he is
good in Dhanishta in Aquarius in the 10th house. Mars is the
Lord of 7th and 12th for Taurus, who otherwise will give mixed
results. In the case of Cancer, he should not be in Aswini 4th
quarter to avoid neecha navamsa (See notes for sloka 5 of this
chapter and also /a taka Parijata , ch. 6, sloka 36).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Counted from Mars, if Jupiter is in the 5th, the Moon in
the 3rd and the Sun in the 9th, the person will become a king
and equal himself to Kubera (the controller of Nava Nidhis for
gods).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: In the above combination, Jupiter can throw his spe-
cial aspect on the Sun and Mars simultaneously. This Yoga is
specially good for the natives of Aries, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Pi-
sces and Leo, if formed in good houses. Should Mars be in the
8th, then the effect is not great.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Also see Jataka Parijata, ch. 7, sloka 12 and Saravali, (my
English translation) where views similar to the sloka under com-
ment can be noted.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Even if one planet is in exaltation and aspected by a friend, a
king is bom. If the said planet be in the Lagna along with a friend,
one becomes a king with grains and wealth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
When even one planet is exhlted while Moon is in her own
house in Lagna, with strength, one bom in a royal family will
become a king and will be respected by the public.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Benefics in 3, 6, 10 and 11 while malefics are relegated to
Lagna and the Zenith, the native will surely become a king of the
earth and be saluted (by all). He will be also versed in politics.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
A king equal to devendra is born if Venus with strength
occupies the 11th or 12th, while Mars is cleanly posited in Lagna
(i.e. well posited) identical with Makara and Saturn is in the 9th

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
or 12th. (The position of Venus as above can also be interpreted
independent of Mars /Saturn.) Should the Moon and the Sun be
in the 7th house, a fickleminded king is born.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The Rajayoga with reference to Makara Lagna is men-
tioned in Saravali (35/136, my English translation) and Jataka
Parijata (7/52).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If malefics are relegated to the 11th, the 3rd and the 6th,
while the lord of tire Moon sign is aspected by a benefic, one will
be a king, revered by all, and will be a virtuous man.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: This view is supported by Jataka Parijata, ch. 7, sloka
51 as well as Saravali, ch. 35, sloka 174 (my English version).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Only males born in odd lagnas and females of even lagnas
enjoy the said yoga. In the case of a male, Bhagya Yoga is formed
in day birth, if all the planets are in odds rasis (i.e. Aries, Gemini
etc.) and the Moon be waxing. Similarly for females bom in night
time (i.e. after the sun-set and before the sun-rise.).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Phala Deepika has Maha Bhagya Yoga in ch. 6 which
is formed thus: For day births, males should have the ascen-
dant, the Sun and the Moon in odd rasis and for night births,
female should have the ascendant, the Sun and the Moon in
even rasis.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One born in Bhagya Yoga will be a scholar, intent on doing
auspicious things, know celestial music and possess elephants
and wealth. Bhagya Yoga will be more effective if there is addi-
tionally a benefic in Lagna.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The effects for Maha Bhagya Yoga of Phala Deepika
are: The native has palanquins at his disposal along with fly-flap

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
(insignia of royalty), musical instruments, and proclamations,
has everlasting wealth, is respected by great men, takes to virtu-
ous path, worships forefathers, gods and Brahmins, is good
hearted and brings credit to his family.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Base men with Raja Yogas will become kings. And those
born in royal scion will rule the earth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Thus ends the 20th Chapter entitled "Raja Yogas" in
Horasara of Prithuyasas, son of Varaha Mihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One bom at the time of sun-rise (i.e. with the sun in Lagna)
will not be quiet and calm, neither will he have many sons. He
will be unkind, be fond of war, weak sighted, will speak less, live
in other countries and be happy.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The person born with Sun in Aries will be famous, strong,
semi blind, wealthy and learned. Should the Sun be in Libra, the
native will be without valour and he will be poor for most part of
his life and will do base deeds.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native with the Sun in Leo will be head of his scion. One
with the Sun in Cancer will be intelligent and firm. The Sun in
Pisces will make one serve females. In Virgo, the Sun makes one
devoted to his wife. The person will be ungrateful.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native with the Sun in the 2nd will have facial diseases.
He will be wealthy and incur royal wrath and fear of theft. In the

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
3rd house. The Sun makes one irascible and strong. Such native's
death occurs among his relatives. He will be famous.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One who has the Sun in the 4th house will not have money of
his own, will be distressed, wise and valorous. The one who has
the Sun in the 5th house will be a fast speaker, will have sharp
memory, few sons, and be not wealthy.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
When the Sun is posited in the 6th, one will be king’s minis-
ter, a leader, be learned and famous. Should the planet be in the
7th, one will be playful, be not attached to his wife and will have
an unquiet disposition.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sun be in the 8th house, one’s eye sight will be
defective. There will not be many children. Sickness and fame
will be both present in the life of the native. The Sun in 9th house
will make one virtuous. The native will have wife and sons will
dislike his father.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The person who has the Sun in the 10th house will attend to
royal duties at all times, be brave and like wars. He will be
widely famous. One with the Sun in the 11th house will become
very rich, will have amicable servants and be dear to the king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sim be in the 12th house one will not have money,
be disabled, afflicted and be in other countries. The Sun in debili-
tation amsa and inimical amsa will increase the affliction to the
Bhava concerned.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon be in Aries, Taurus or Cancer as Lagna, the
native will be wealthy, happy and equal to a king. In other rasis
identical with the Lagna, the Moon does not give speech, wis-
dom, wealth and strength.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon be in the 2nd house, one will be coura-
geous, rich and dear to women and will be happy with little. In
the 3rd house, the Moon will give calumnating tendency,
kindlessness, and cunningness.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Moon is in the 4th house, one will have sweet food, be
modest, addicted to women and be happy. Should she be in the
5th house, one will possess wife, wisdom and strength. His
wealth will be hard earned.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native who has the Moon in the 6th will be idle and poor
and will have many foes. He will curb or overpower his co-
boms. Should the Moon be in the 7th house, the native will be
close to his wife, be a leading person in the king's employ, will be
liberal.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon be in the 8th house, one will be wealthy,
will enjoy luxuries, will be wise and very courageous.In the 9th
house, she will make one virtuous, talkative, go after women,
and preside over money {i.e. be wealthy).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native who has the Moon in 10th will gather money by
all (fair) means. He will have an artful and clever wife. Should
the Moon be in the 11th house, one will be rich and a good
scholar. He will possess cows, be acceptable to the king and be
modest.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One who has the Moon in the 12th will have afflicted eyes,
defective limb, sufferings from women and he will be
fickleminded. Should, however, the 12th be the own or exaltation
house for the Moon, or she be waxing though in the 12th, happi-
ness and wealth will follow.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One having Mars in the Lagna, will have an injured limb, be
brave and strong. He will be respected and mighty. He will also
be fickleminded, short-lived, wild, idle and be troubled by bil-
ious diseases.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native who has Mars in the 2nd house will have high
incidence of expenses, a limb cirppled and be harsh in speech. He
will dislike his brothers and earn money with difficulty, become
rich and be lucky.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Mars in the 4th will make one desirous of living in others'
houses, sick and wealthy. In the 5th, it makes a person grieved,
ill-natured and quite intelligent.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars be in the 6th, one will be base and idle. If he be
in the 7th, the native will subdue to his wife and live in foreign
countries. The 8th house Mars will make one's existence difficult.
The person will be forsaken by his wife and sons,

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: FIT$ URt yuTrcS^ «Wl 'irddli^^lHl RT II 21 II

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars be in the 9th, one will indulge in killing the
people on the way. If in 10th the subject will become dear to the
public and be highly intelligent. If in 11th, the native will have
excellent qualities, and in 12th the native will be a befallen person
and be disabled.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Mercury in the Ascendant will make one learned, wealthy
and kind. In the second, it makes one rich and lucky. Should the
planet be in the 3rd, the subject will become rich on account of his
own good qualities. In the 4th he will be scholarly and learned.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Mercury in the 5th-very intelligent, sweet in speech, wise
and accepted even by scholars. In the 6th~the native will be of
argumentative nature, will hate the public and live in foreign
countries.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One who has Mercury in the 7th will be a Mimamsaka know-
ing the right and wrong course of action, be liberal minded and
widely famous. In the 8th, Mercury makes one famous, lord of
money, king and wise.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the planet be in tlie 9th house, one will be very brave,
will possess wealth and corn and be very enthusiastic, and in the
10th one will become lord of money, give donations, be intelli-
gent and famous.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mercury be in the 11th house, the native will earn in
several (fair) ways and be rich, be dear to women and of good
qualities. If in the 12th house, one will be cruel, unkind and
spendthrift.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Jupiter be in the 1st house, the native will be longlived,
wise and happy. This does not apply if the planet be in fall. In the
2nd house, it makes one wealthy, a good speaker, kind and
interested in worshipping the gods.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Jupiter in the 3rd will give bad disposition and no wealth.
The person will be ominous to his co-bom and relatives. In the
4th house, the planet makes one happy, and gives good wife. The
subject will have good food, residence, conveyances etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: According to Bhavartha Ratnakara Jupiter in 3rd in
fall will give charitable mind.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Jupiter in the 5th house will give good wife and sons. He will
be fortunate, a scholar, and an able speaker. In the 6th, the planet
will give no enemies, make him a minister of the king and pru-
dent.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The planet Jupiter in 7th will bless one with good wife and
sons, and make him a better scholar than ever before. In the 8th,
it contributes to long lease of life. The native will become a king,
be learned and have his force of enemies destroyed.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Jupiter in the 9th will make one enjoy all kinds of happiness.
The native will be learned, splendorous, virtuous and wealthy. In
the 10th house, it will bestow wide fame, engagement in good
acts and make very wealthy.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
When Jupiter is placed in the 11th house, the person will
have gains from various sources, become head of a treasury (i.e.
immensely rich), principal member of his clan and well versed.
In the 12th, it makes a person defective limbed and spend money
in charity and dances.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Venus in Lagna gives such beauty equal to Manmatha and
also qualities. The person will be won by women, be wealthy,
and versed. When the said planet is in 2nd, one will be conscien-
tious, wealthy, have cheerful face and be kind.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One will join base women for the sake of sensual pleasures if
Venus is in the 3rd house. He will not have wealth and luxuries.
If the planet Venus is in the 4th house, one will be happy and will
tend to pardon others. He will be kind and have wife and sons.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Venus be in the 5th house, one will be a king's minis-
ter, or a leader. He will have female issues and be learned- In the
6th, it makes one be without enemies, be of cunning disposition
and sickly. He will also lose his wealth and sons.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Venus be in the 7th, the person will be infatulated
with passion, will hate his friends and will be close to chief
persons. If it be in the 8th house, one will be of varied nature,
sick, will have wife and children and he will be delighted.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Venus be strong in the 9th, one will possess wisdom,
virtues, luxuries, wife and sons. In thelOth house-one will be
dear to women, become a king’s minister and will dig wells,
tanks etc. for the public.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Venus in the 11th gives superior knowledge, wealth, kind-
ness, gains and satisfaction. If in 12th, it makes a person go after
women, otherwise righteous, but undutiful. If the 12th be the
own house or exaltation house of Venus one will be wealthy and
marry a famous lady.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Sjhould Saturn be in Lagna, the native will be very sick in his
boyhood, be dirty and a wanderer. He will also be wicked in

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
nature. He will not be loyal to the fair sex, be windy in-tempera-
ment, he will be disabled, if Saturn is in own house or is exalted,
in the Lagna, the person will be principal in his clan, wise,
welathy and be a king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Saturn occupies the 2nd house, the native will not have any
money left by his father. He will have self respect, courage,
wealth and be learned. If he be in 3rd, one will be brave, unkind,
witty and disrespected.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Saturn is in the 4th hosue, one will be troubled by his own
relatives, will not have many sons and will be unhappy. If he be
in the 5th house the native will be dun, will have limited number
of sons and suffer from eye diseases. He will be a wanderer.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Saturn is in the 6th, the native will be helpful, be free from
enemies and diseases, and be very famous. Should he be in the
7th, one will be mean, fickleminded, grieved and will be fond of
his wife though she will be wicked.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Saturn is in the 8th, one will be wealthy, sick, will not have
many sons, will be weak sighted and fickleminded. If in the 9th,
one will hold the flag of Dharma aloft, be a great expert, be
greatly wise and just and will have sons.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Saturn be in the 10th, one will have good mental
disposition, will be wealthy, chief of his caste, and happy. If it be
in the 11th the native will be of lordly disposition, famous, will be

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: a scientist and expert in use of weapons (and surgery).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Saturn is in 12th, the native will blame others, be burdened
with heavy expenditure and be unhappy. Should Saturn be in a
house, along with its lord, the benef, ■ and malefic results will be
dependent on both.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
A planet in fall or inimically placed will adversely affect the
Bhava in question. Whatever has been said in regard to the 12
Bhavas with reference to Lagna equally applies when counted
from the Moon.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The results of various Bhavas can be predicted from the
Moon and the Lagna. Such results for every rasi can be predicted
accurately. The results of Bhavas will be wider if three or more
planets be in one Bhava.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Prithuyasas does not prefer a cluster of planets in any
Bhava and feels that such combinations will not always yield
good results. Also see sloka 1 of chapter 23 of this work.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Garga Hora which exclusively deals with 2-7 planetary com-
binations as well as Jataka Parijatha ch. 8 and Saravali, ch. 15 to
ch. 19 may also be referred.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Thus ends the 21st Chapter entitled "Results of
planets in the several Bhavas" in Horasara
of Prihuyasas, son of Varaha Mihira

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One's obtainment of wealth (i.e. one's livelihood) is the prod-
uct of his own inner nature. Such wealth is acquired through the
planets posited in the 10th house counted from the ascendant,
the Moon and the Sun or the respective Navamsas.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Money comes through father, mother, brother, relative, elder
(or preceptor), wife and low class men according to the planet
concerned be Sun etc. as indicated by the position in the 10th
from Lagna the Sun or the Moon.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: According to Jataka Parijata, ch. 15, sloka 43, the 10th
house from Lagna or the Moon, if occupied by Mars, notes
income through enemies, by Mercury through friends and by
Jupiter through brothers. For other planets, same view of
Horasara is found. The view of Jataka Parijata confirms to that of
Phala Deepika. However, all the three views are correct as these
are additional indications,

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the 10th be planetless, then the strongest among the Moon
or the Sun should be considered. The Lord of the sign in which

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
the 10th Lord is posited may also be considered. (That is the said
navamsas will denote the kind of livelihood.)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Also see sloka 1, ch. 5 of Phala Deepika. The lord of
navamsa occupied by the strongest 10th lord counted from
Lagna, Sun or Moon decides the profession factor.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the lord of such amsa be the Sun, the person earns
through fruits, trees, medicines, metals, sculpture, betting, false-
hood, cheating and royal sources.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: If the Sun is in 10th from Moon, the native achieves
professional success, financial status, kingly status and prosper-
ity. ( Saravali , ch. 33, my English translation). The Sun in 10th
from Moon or Lagna is an attractive position for politicians and
is also good for liaison with or favours from Government.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The Moon's amsa in such case indicates: pearls, carriers run
in water, husbandry, water, clothes etc., cows, buffaloes, sugar,
female’s company, chanting mantras, hymns and the like and
worship of gods.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Full Moon in 10th from Lagna or simply the Moon in
10th from the Sun is indicative of maternal inheritance. This
position encourages dealings in jewels, ships, boats, fish etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Such amsa of Mars denotes: teaching, mantras, bravery,
weapons (or surgery etc.), fire, medicines, selling in market and
through Kshatriyas (i.e. persons of royal scion).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Mars in 10th from Lagna, Moon or the Sim is capable
of making one engaged in military services. One rises according
to the strength of Mars. Further, one will be engaged in selling
arms and ammunitions, or will have fair opportunity to shine in

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.
