metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
In such amsa of Mercury, the livelihood is through; writings,
drawings, literature, mathematics, bets, dancing, donations (i.e.
the person will receive donations in marriages, Sraddhas etc.),
education and loving speech.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes; If Mercury is in the 10th from Lagna or Moon (he
cannot be in the 10th from Sun as his maximum longation is 28°)
the native earns through astrology, magic, dance, drama, scien-
tific research etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should such amsa be of Jupiter, the means of livelihood will
be from-education, worship of gods (he. temple priesthood).
Mantras, Japas, exposition of Mantras, knowledge of the three
periods (i.e. astrology), Shakunas and royal favours.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Jupiter in 10th is good for astrology, medicine, justice,
politics etc., dealing with sale of gold, jewels etc will give great
success.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Venus be the lord of such amsa, the livelihood will be
through: cows, buffaloes, horses, elephants etc, the company of
women, medicines, beautification, singing etc and one will be
happy through these.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Venus in the 10th from Lagna Moon is a congenial
position for running dairy, textile mills, such showrooms,
jewellery shops, operas, cinemas etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the said amsa be of Saturn, the source of living will
be; fruits, roots, leaves, carrying loads, labour, base men, ser-
vants, sales of grain and inferior grains labour carrying

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
loads, base deeds, sesamum, salt, grains, vegetables, grass, fire-
wood, water etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The third line has a few words missing. The repetition
of some words are hence unaccountable.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Saturn in 10th from lagna. Moon or Sun is capable of bestow-
ing success in fields like steel, coal, minerals, black articles, buf-
faloes etc. Those who have Saturn in 10th can rise to high legal
profession. But this 10th house position of Saturn at some time or
the other can befall the person from dizzy heights, if it is ad-
versely placed at birth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the planet owning the amsa to be very strong, one
will earn money effortlessly, and if in deep fall, the results men-
tioned will manifest in little proportion.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: Notes: See notes under sloka 15 of this chapter.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The astrologer should advise (the means of livelihood) in the
direction of the country indicated (by a study of the horoscope)
or the country suitable to the 10th house from Lagna.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: This aspect should be studied with reference to
ashtaka varga also.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The sages say that if the said houses are aspected by their
own lords, then the native will earn in his own country, and if
aspected by or conjoined with other planets, the livelihood will
be in other countries.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the lord of the said amsa be in a movable rasi or amsa, the
native earns even when in other countries /places and be happy;
if in fixed rasi or amsa, the earnings will be only in his native
country and if in dual rasi or amsa, the earnings will be any-
where.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: If the lord of navamsa (occupied by 10th lord from
Moon, Lagna or Sun) be strong, one earns effortlessly. The direc-
tion of earning is indicated by the 10th house or the Navamsa
occupied by 10th lord. If the 10th house receives the aspect of its
lord or is occupied by him, or if the 10th is a fixed sign, one earns
in his native place. If tire 10th house is occupied or aspected by
others, the native's livelihood is in other places or other coun-
tries. (Phala Deepika, ch. 5, sloka 9).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the lord of said amsa be in retrograde motion, money
will be acquired in many ways. And one's earning will be pro-
portionate to one's own luck. The results have already been
enumerated in full.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Even one strong benefic in 10th from the Moon, unaspected
by or unconjoined with malefics, is enough to make a person
enjoy fame for him and his family till the end of yuga. The
counting applies similarly to the Lagna also.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Thus ends the 22nd Chapter in Horasara of Prithuyasas, son
of Varaha Mihira

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The combination of two or more planets always affects the
Bhava concerned. The effects of such combination may also yield
a poisonous mixture as honey and ghee together yield.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The author mentions in the following sloka that for
the above reason, the results of planetary combination, he would
explain special effects thereof. Thus, the present sloka means to
say that the effect of the conjunction of two or more planets with
respect to one bhava is different from a planet being alone.
Compare this with slokas 53 and 54 of this chapter.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The brief results of such planetary combinations are ex-
plained infra. The results arising out of planetary transits should
be correlated by the astrologer before issuing predictions.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Sun and Mercury are together in the 4th house or in the
8th house from the ascendant, the person born will be equal to a
king in qualities and be wealthy. This conjunction in other houses
will make one virtuous.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The conjunction of Mercury and the Sun in 4th is not
praised by Vaidyanatha in Jataka parijata, ch. 8, for he says: he

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
becomes a king and overpowers his enemies. He becomes fa-
mous but his mother is of questionable character. (Reference
Jataka Parijata)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: See also sloka 15 of this chapter.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The combination of the Sun and Mars in the 10th, the 11th,
the Lagna or the 8th causes one's birth in a great family and
bestows great strength, whereas this conjunction in other houses
gives no wealth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: Notes: Saravali also corroborates the above view in toto

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Refer Jataka Parijata: This yoga in Lagna makes one bilious,
brave in war, wounded, cruel and hard hearted. In the 4th, it
deprives of relatives, peace of mind etc. and people blame him.
In the 7th, one is bereaved of separation from wife, disrespected
by women, and is intent on living in foreign countries. In the
10th, all his undertakings are unfruitful and he serves a king but
remains over worried .

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Sun and Jupiter be together in the Ascendant, the 9th,
the 10th or the 11th, the native has strong command and fame
and will be inaccessible, (i.e. he will be too big a oerson *^-be
reached by all.)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Reference Jataka Parijata: This yoga in Lagna makes
one a minister or army chief. He may also take to ascetism. He is
learned, wealthy and happy. In the 4th, one is well versed in
Vedas, justice etc. He is surrounded by servants and is virtuous.
In the^th, one is a subordinate of women due to the predomi-
nance of Manmatha i.e. Love God, has an auspicious physique
(i.e. no defect in the body), and possesses gold, silver etc. But he
hates his father. In the 10th, one becomes a famous king and has
all comforts and wealth. These results out of the angular occupa-
tion of these two will be felt even by a low bom man.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
But he remains unmarried or becomes a widower. If in 10th, he
becomes a king and overpowers his enemies. He becomes fa-
mous but his mother is of questionable character. (Reference

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The combination of the Sun and Mars in the 10th, the 11th,
the Lagna or the 8th causes one's birth in a great family and
bestows great strength, whereas this conjunction in other houses
gives no wealth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: Notes: Saravali also corraborates the above view in toto.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Refer Jataka Parijata: This yoga in Lagna makes one bilious,
brave in war, wounded, cruel and hard hearted. In the 4th, it
deprives of relatives, peace of mind etc. and people blame him.
In the 7th, one is bereaved of separation from wife, disrespected
by women, and is intent on living in foreign countries. In the
10th, all his undertakings are unfruitful and he serves a king but
remains over worried.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Sun and Jupiter be together in the Ascendant, the 9th,
the 10th or the 11th, the native has strong command and fame
and will be inaccessible, (i.e. he will be too big a person to be
reached by all).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Reference Jataka Parijata: This yoga in Lagna makes
one a minister or army chief. He may also take to ascetism. He is
learned, wealthy and happy. In the 4th, one is well versed in
Vedas, justice etc. He is surrounded by servants and is virtuous.
In the 10th, one is a subordinate of women due to the predomi-
nance of Manmatha i.e. Love god, has an auspicious physique
(i.e. no defect in the body), and possesses gold, silver etc. But he
hates his father. In thelOth, one becomes a famous king and has
all comforts and wealth. These results out of the angular occupa-
tion of these two will be felt even by a low bom man.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The conjunction of the Sun and Venus occurring in the 10th,
the 8th or the 5th makes a person equal to a king, famous and
mighty. In other houses, these two together will give only penury
and unhappiness.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The combination of Sun and Venus in Lagna pro-
motes quarrels, gives little common sense, much sorrow and
inharmonious married life. In the 7th, women hate him, and he
suffers poverty. The 10th house position is welcome in that the
native enjoys ministerial position, financial prosperity, convey-
ances etc. (See Saravali, ch. 31).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sun and Saturn dwell in the 9th, the 2nd or the
6th together, they give widespread fame and happiness. In other
bhavas, their company leads to no wealth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Should Saturn and Sun be together in Lagna, the
native is born to a blameworthy mother. The 4th house position
is not good for cordial relationship with the relatives. In 7th, they
do not promote marital harmony. Should they join in the 10th,
one serves the king and gathers money only to lose in theft. (See
Jataka Parijata, ch. 8.)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: Saravali, ch. 31 has the same view.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Sun-Saturn combination is good for mineral trade. ( Phala
Deepika, ch. 18)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
In actual practice, any relationship between these two
planets will tell upon the father. Some have lost their father early
in childhood, some have no good terms with father. Their combi-
nation in the 11th is of course superior and one becomes fortu-
nate. Even a Sagittarius native is happy with the 2nd lord in
exaltation in 11th, not greatly affected by the Sun in fall simulta-
neously.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars and the Moon be together in the 10th, the 9th,
the 5th or the 11th, one will become wealthy and be equal to a
king. In other Bhavas, one is deprived of his relatives and happi-
ness as well.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The Moon-Mars yoga goes by the designation *tM«H
yoga, a financial boost. This is, however, inauspicious for
mother.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
These two in the Lagna give blood disorder and bilious
complaints. In the 4th, they are adverse for children. Poverty
results if they join in 7th. (See Saravali ch. 31).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Mars in Lagna, 4th or 7th is not good for females, in the
matter of marriage, apart from 2nd and 8th. Should Moon join
Mars, it is further complicated. In order to mitigate such evil,
Jupiter, Venus, the 7th lord and the 8th lord should be strong.
The partner's 7th lord in strength and in good aspect is another
source of relief for the female concerned.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native will be learned in poetry and arts and be wealthy
if he has Mercury and the Moon together in the 3rd, 11th, 6th or
the 8th in his nativity. If in other houses, one will be fearless and
indigenent.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: See Saravali, Moon-Mercury in Lagna: Happy, steady
mind, strong, liked by many, fluency in talk, intelligence etc. In
the 4th: has relatives, sons, friends, respect, gold, conveyances
etc . In the 7th: respect, reputation, soft body, proficient in writing
and liked by a well placed person. In the 10th: rich, ministerial
position, but at the end, separation from relatives follows.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The conjunction of Moon and Mercury makes one famous
and lucky. (Phala Deepika, ch. 18).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
He wilt be sweet tongued, clever in interpreting, famous and
lucky ( Brihat Jataka, ch. 14).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Jupiter and the Moon be not in the 3rd or the 6th or
depressed, the native with a combination of these two, will be
wealthy. He will have wife and sons and be well-mannered.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The combination should not take place in the 3rd or in
the 6th or the rasi concerned should not be Capricorn or Scorpio.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should these two join in Lagna, the native has broad and
prominent chest, and becomes a king with sons and relatives. If
in the 4th, one is equal to king and himself a minister. In the 7th
business man and dear to king. In the 10th— long hand, good
education and financial gains. ( Saravali and Jataka Parijata).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
In a different context, Vaidyanatha forms Rajayoga in his
Jataka Parijata with debilitated Jupiter in Lagna in Capricorn
while the Sun is in Leo rasi or amsa. (ch. 7, sloka 15.) In our
opinion, the Sun be better in Cancer in 2nd Navamsa so that the
condition laid down is fulfilled.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Venus and the Moon be together in the 10th house,
one will be an expert trader, will enjoy good robes and life and
will lord over money. If this combination be in the 12th house, he
will obtain money from foreign countries.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: These two planets in Lagna give beautiful body and
enjoyment with whores and wife. Should they join in 4th, one is
happy with wife and issues and has earnings through ships etc. If
it is 7th house, one enjoys with many women and has little
wealth and few sons. In the 10th house, these two bless with
many servants, fame, royalty and ministerslup. (Jataka Parijata,
ch. 8)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Mars and Saturn be together in the 9th, the 5th, the 4th, the
10th or the 2nd, one will have sons, relatives, virtue and wealth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One is unlucky and dirty if he has these two planets in other
Bhavas than those mentioned.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Mars and Saturn in Lagna curtail longevity. In the
4th, the native is a sinner and has no friend. In the 7th, one is
deprived of marital comforts. One gets money through king with
Mars and Saturn in the 10th house. (Jataka Parljata, ch. 8).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Mars and Saturn in the 7th in Cancer give a chaste and
beautiful wife an exception indeed, made by Mantreswara in
Phala Deepika, ch. 10, sloka 3, see Patni Sathi Sobhan. Saturn if
not well placed and be in the 7th gives an ugly wife with protrud-
ing teeth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The Moon and Saturn together give an emaciated body. Such
native will be bent upon doing base deeds, will dislike his mo tire r
and will be a fool. In 3, 6, 10 and 11, the said planets together
bestow all kinds of wealth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: Notes: See notes under sloka 5 of this chapter.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars and Mercury be in one hosue, the native has no
steady mind. He will be satisfied with little. He will be dirty and
like to eat others' food. Should these two planets be in an angle,
the native will get wealth and be happy.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: If Mars and Mercury join in Lagna, the native is
expert in fire and mineral works, becomes an ambassador and
protects others' things. If they join in the 4th, he will have con-
veyances, friends, money etc., but will be deprived of relatives. If
in the 7th, the native loses his first wife, changes place and is
argumentative in nature. Should Mars and Mercury join in 10th,
the native becomes an army chief, brave and cruel. He earns
royal favour. (Jataka Parijata, ch. 8).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Mars and Jupiter be in one house, the native will be long
lived, will obtain sons, will be well-behaved. Should these, how-
ever, be in evil houses, i.e. (6th, 8th or 12th), the person will be
addicted to vices, be sick and will have not much wealth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: If Mars and Jupiter are in Lagna, one acquires a chief
post, is always enthusiastic and interested in religious field. If
they join in 4th, the native is engaged in royal service. In the 7th,
their conjunction makes one brave, move in hills, forts etc., and
have good relatives. But this position is not congenial for marital
harmony. These two planets in 10th make one famous and very
wealthy. He will have a large family and is equal to a king.
(Jataka Parijata, ch. 8).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The conjunction of Jupiter and Mars is very good for Leo,
Aries, Sagittarius, Scorpio, Cancer and Pisces Ascendants.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Mars and Venus are disposed in one house, the native will
be fickleminded, will be at his wife's disposal and will indulge in
wicked acts. Should the said conjunction be in the 1st, 4th or
10th, one will be chief of his caste or head of the village.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Should Mars and Venus be in Lagna, the native is of
bad disposition, does bad deeds, is addicted to prostitutes and
shortlived. He loses money through women. If they are in 4th,
the native is deprived of sons and friends and suffers mental
agony. Their conjunction in the 7th makes one addicted to
women. He will not hav* raiseworthy history. In the 10th, one
is famous, wealthy and a minister to king. (Jataka Parijata ch. 8).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Mars and Saturn in one house give windy troubles (i.e. rheu-
matism etc), and bilious complaints. Should they be in 3rd, 6th,
10th or 11th house, such effects cannot be anticipated; on the
other hand, the native will be equal to a king, liked by all and
famous.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Mecury and Jupiter are in one house, one will be deaf,
learned and will have eye diseases. If they be specifically in the
12th, 8th or 6th, one will be lucky, famous and virtuously dis-
posed.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: If the conjunction of Mercury and Jupiter is in Lagna,
the native has pleasing personality, is virtuous, learned and is
blessed with various pleasures. He is respected by the king.
Should it be the 4th house, where these two planets are together,
the native is recipient of regal favours, wealthy and has friends,
wife etc. If they join in the 7th house, the native has good wife, is
wealthy and excels his father. In the 10th, one is equal to a king
or is a minister, is wealthy and learned. ( Vide Jataka Parijata).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mercury and Venus be in one house, the native will
be maimed (or spiritless); his welfare (or prosperity) will be
checkered. He will have mean wife and sons and yet he will be
affectionate to them. Should the conjunction be in the 9th, the 5th
or the 1st, he will earn titles and immense money.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Mercury and Venus and Lagna: beautiful, healthy
and learned and honoured by the king. In the 4th: pleasing
physique, friends, children and relatives. The native becomes a
king or minister. In the 7th: one enjoys the company of cute
dames. He is very wealthy and attached to a king. ThelOth house
combination makes the native wise in politics, a king, virtuous
and wealthy. He ompletes every undertaking successfully and ,
patronises good people. (Jataka Parijata, ch. 8.)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mercury and Saturn be in the 10th, 1st or in the 9th,
one will have wealth, wife, sons and friends. Their conjunction in
other houses, will yield inauspicious results.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: If Mercury and Saturn join in Lagna, the native has
dirty appearance, is sinful and has no wealth and conveyances.
He is short lived and unlucky. In the 4th: the native is deprived
of food, friends, relatives etc. In the 7th: the native is very dirty,
not virtuous, not helpful etc. In the 10th: he wins his enemies, is
wealthy and has conveyances. (Jataka Parijata, ch. 8). Thus
Horasara praises the combination of Mercury and Saturn in
Lagna while Jataka Parijata does not. The view of Vaidyanatha is
mostly true. Moreover, their combination in Lagna promotes
sexual inability of the native. And in the 7th, the spouse receives
such results.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Jupiter and Venus join in the 1st, 5th, 9th or 8th, the native
will enjoy wife, wealth and sons. Should the conjunction be in
other houses, one will be troubled by diseases and be sorrowful.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Jupiter and Venus together in Lagna make one a king.
In the 4th many conveyances. In the 7th-good wife, wealthy
superior conveyances etc. In the 10th, many servants, abundant
wealth etc. (Jataka Parijata. ch. 8). Generally this combination is
good for wealth, luck, conveyances etc. Even Sagittarius natives
are well-placed with this combination, though Venus is 6th lord.
Similarly Libra natives also do well though Jupiter is the 6th lord.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Jupiter and Saturn be in houses other then 3, 6, 10 and 11,
the native will have no self-respect and money. Should the com-
bination occur in the 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th, one will be famous
and be worshipped by the king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Should these two be in Lagna, the native is lazy,
learned and has little comforts. In the 4th-good health, success
over enemies, dear to all and good relatives. In the 7th— not
atractive in appearance, dull headed and intent on gaining pater-
nal property. In the 10th equal to a king, few children and many
conveyances, (/afaka Parijata, ch. 8.)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The conjunction of Saturn and Jupiter is cogenial for medical
achievements, legal proficiency and mining etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
As suggested by our present work, their conjunction in
Upachaya is a boon to the owner of the radix.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Venus and Saturn be in Lagna, the 5th, the 9th, the
4th, 7th or the 10th, one will be commanded by his wife, be a
chief in royal service and wealthy. In other houses, this combina-
tion will deprive one of his strength and money.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: At the outset, the combination of Venus and Saturn or
Venus and Mars is not at all practically good for a happy and
long married life, irrespective of the bhava which has this combi-
nation. The malefic results will pronouncedly be felt if they join
in Lagna, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th. Now see what Saravali says
regarding Venus and Saturn joining together: In Lagna: beautiful
and wealthy. In the 4th: gains through friends and relatives,
honoured by king and wealthy. In the 7th: good for money, wife,
fame etc. In the 10th: famous in the world, highly placed and
minister.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The conjunction of Venus and Saturn makes one a boxing
champion, an alchemist etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
With the conjunction of the Sun, the Moon and Mars the
native will be most sinfully disposed. His livelihood will not
have much progress. He will be without relative, wife and chil-
dren. He will be disabled. He will be blamed by the public and be
a miser.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: For Slokas from 26 to 52 of this chapter, notes ap-
pended are from Saravali , ch. 16.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Sun-Moon-Mars: shameless, sinful deeds, ability to make
and handle machinery, will eliminate the whole band of enemies,
courageous, clever in all things.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sun, Mars and Mercury be in one house, the
native will be against righteous deeds. He will live in distant
countries, be a miser and be unkind. The wealth acquired by him
will vanish and he will be sorrowful.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Sun-Mars-Mercury in one house: reputed, daring
without care for consequences, cruel, shameless, bereft of wife
and children, wrestling ability.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The combination of the Sun, Mercury and Jupiter in one
house will make a person intelligent, dear to a king, penniless at
the end and thus dependant on others even for a morsel of food.
The native will hurt others' feelings.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Sun-Mercury-Jupiter in one house--Eye disease, great
wealth, famous for scholarship, proficient writer, fluent talk.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Sun, Jupiter and Venus are in one sign, the person will
be intent upon giving donations, praised by the public and be a
king. He will be cheated by women and in gambling and thus be
devoid of his wealth. He will have trouble from enemies. He will
suffer from grief.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Sun-Jupi ter- Venus in one house: courageous, poor,
ophthalmic, dear to king and helpful.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sun, Venus and Saturn be in one house, the native
will be devoid of religious codes, be a big cheat, and be miser-
able. He will not have any income. He will be sick. But in his old
age he will possess some money.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Sun, Venus and Saturn in one house: fear from his
enemies, no self respect, suffers leprosy, bad ancestrv and little
academic achievements.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Moon, Mars and Mercury be in one house, the native
will become famous, be worshipped by the public, learned, elo-
quent in speech, kind and will be penniless in the middle of his
life.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Moon, Mars and Mercury in one house: mean habits,
no children, no relatives and friends.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Moon, Mercury and Jupiter be in one house, the native
will have a widely exalted status. He will be very learned, rich,
valorous and a king.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Moon, Mercury and Jupiter in one house: Rich, re-
nowned, dear to king, many children, many brothers and high
status in life.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native will undoubtedly become a king if the Moon,
Jupiter and Venus be in one house. He will have elephants,
horses, conveyances, serving force, treasury etc., at his com-
mand.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Moon, Jupiter and Venus in one house: learned yet
devoted to mean acts, greedy and jealous.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon, Venus and Saturn be in one house, the
native will have self-respect, be rich and kind. He will have
luxuries at his disposal. His position in life will be neither great
nor insignificant. He will have sons and cattle and be respected

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Moon, Venus and Saturn in one house: learned
teacher, astrologer and author.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Moon, Saturn and the Sun join in one rasi, one will not
acquire much riches. He will be accosted by diseases and be
aggrieved. He will go abegging and be disabled. His means of
livelihood will be service and dance.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Moon, Saturn and Sun in one house: passionate, fool-
ish argumentative, pauper, serves others.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars, Mercury and Venus join in a single rasi, one
will be sick right from the childhood, to a small extent. He will be
in a position to remain jocularly disposed, be a prince, and be a
widely famed.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Mars, Mercury and Venus in one house-mean birth,
defective organ, fickle minded, cruel and sweet talk.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars, Jupiter and Venus be in one house, the native
will have conveyances and attendants at his disposal. He will
attain great fame and wealth. He will possess issues and lands
and enjoy greatly.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Mars, Jupiter and Venus in one house— liked by king,
virtuous sons, enjoys company of beautiful girls, pleases all.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars, Venus and Saturn be in one house, it is omi-
nous for the mother of the subject. He will wander in foreign

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
countries and be addicted to other ladies.' He will be base and be
insulted by royal circles.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars, Saturn and the Sun be in conjunction, the
native will be in a sinner. He will deceive others' wives. He will
have a short span of life. His end will occur in a foreign country
through poison, fire or jail.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Mars, Saturn and Sun in one house: diseases, defec-
tive organs and ignorance.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Mars, the Sun and Mercury be in one house, one will ever
be roaming. From time to time, he will gather some grains and
cook them (i.e. he will have to make efforts for every square meal
on day-to-day basis.)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The conjunction of Mercury, Jupiter and Venus will make the
native a king. His possessions will be plentiful. He will be mod-
est. His fame will be spread in the (whole) region.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mercury, Venus and Saturn be in one house, the
native will be ruler of men, wealthy, steady in mind, famous,
longlived, acceptable to all and learned.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mercury, Saturn and the Sun be together, one will
have a very bloody and bilious physique, will hate his own men,
be meanly disposed, will live in foreign countries, will have more

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Sun, Mercury and Saturn in one house: Impotent,
lacks masculine qualities, poor.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mercury, the Sun and Venus be in one house, the
native will enjoy luxuries, wealth and the kind and be among his
parents and relatives. He will have respect and valour.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Mercury, Sun and Venus in one house— dissatisfac-
tion, impolite, likes travels, leaves native place due to the wishes
of elders, sorrow on account of wife.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the planets Mercury, Satum and Mars be together in one
house the native will be a prostitute's husband, be intent on
living in distant countries, be inimical to his men, aggrieved,
shortlived and loses his cattle and wife.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Mercury, Satum and Mars in one house— servitude,
black eyes, ugly personality, diseased mouth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: fatwjl fa<rqt»fi fateqid) cil+thkfi n 46 n

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Jupiter, Venus and Satum join in one house, the native will
be a principal member of his castemen, and be happy with his
family. He will have limited gains and luxuries. He will be fa-
mous and be liked by all.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Jupiter, Venus and Satum-highly praiseworthy hab-
its, will reach royal position though low bom, wide spread repu-
tation.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Jupiter, Mars and the Sun be in conjunction, one will
be wealthy, worshipped by the people, learned and be free from

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: sickness and enemies. He will have every kind of happiness.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Jupiter, Sun and Mars-premier or commander,
wealthy, powerful, keeps up his word.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Jupiter, Mars and Saturn be in conjunction, the native
will be a town's head and be strong. He will put up with difficul-
ties. He will be wealthy, jealously disposed, respected and valor-
ous.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Jupiter, Saturn and the Moon be together, one will be
after women. He will have issues and be happy. He will speak
sweetly and be friendly to the people. He will respect his parents,
preceptors and gods.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Jupiter Moon and Saturn in one house: well versed in
sacred sciences, addicted to women past their prime, free from
diseases, not angrily disposed, leader in society.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native who has three or more planets either in the Ascen-
dant, or the 10th or the 9th, will engage himself in multifarious
activities, will have numerous good qualities, will be extremely
intelligent and will enjoy like a lord of wealth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon, Jupiter and Mars be in one house, they
give vigour and wealth. This is not so in the case of one of them
being in depression, or their being in 6th, 7th or 8th houses.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Moon, Jupiter and Mars: soft body, passionate, steal-
ing tendency, liked by women.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: dyiw-mfeal tosTtot tot tor n 52 h

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Saturn, Moon, Mars and Venus join in 9th, 10th or the
Ascendant, one will not have any bonds of family and relatives,
will live in foreign places and be happy.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Moon, Mars and Saturn-wicked habits, loss of
mother in boyhood, mean status, mischievous and hated by
many.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The effects of two or three planets joining in houses are
subject to change according to Lagna at birth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If benefics only join in a bhava, the effects produced will be
very superior. Inauspicious results will follow if malefics join
together. Combination of planets, if be mixed in nature then the
effects will be equally mixed.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If four or more planets join in a house, only mixed effects will
follow. The results will manifest in the major and subperiods,
depending on the good or bad disposition of the planets.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Thus ends the 23rd Chapter entitled "Conjunctions of two or
more Planets and their Effects" in Horasara of
Prithuyasas son of Varaha Mihira
