metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sun, the Moon and Mars join in 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th,
9th or 12th, being devoid of strength, the notorious Jalayoga is
produced.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: In this chapter, powerful Avayogas are explained
which are capable of imbalancing the good yogas in a nativity.
Before analysing the possible goods from Rajayogas, these ad-
verse combinations should be given equal consideration in order
to arrive at right and sensible conclusions.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native who has the said ^ will be a dunce, unim-
portant and devoid of any wisdom and wealth. He will have no
fixity of mind. He will be stubborn (in the sense, he will not
accept any good thinking) and he will depend on others for food.
He will be subject to mental worries.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Kemadruma yoga (of another kind) is produced when the
lord of the 9th is pushed to the 12th house while the 12th lord is
in the 2nd without strength. Simultaneously, the 3rd house shall
have placement of malefics.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: This Kemadruma is formed with a different planetary
set up as above while the commonly known Kemadruma is
produced thus: The Moon without planets on at least one side or
with her or in her angles. The angular occupation is known to
cancel Kemadruma yoga caused by the Moon without planets in
12th, 2nd or with her.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One born with the Kemadruma yoga (mentioned in the
above sloka) will be after others' housewives, will always look
upto others for his food, will indulge in bad deeds and will
contract several debts.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: T n T Ff T T?t hWI ?ll

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the 7th and 8th be occupied by malefic planets, while
the Lagna Lord is in fall in rasi or navamsa, one born in Gulika
Kala, will destroy his family.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: This yoga means, that his family will end with him
and not descend any further.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
For calculation of Gulika, the following should be noted.
Gulika’s position will correspond to tire rising degree at the
moment noted below:

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
(A) For day birth, Sunday 26 ghatis, Monday 22 ghatis, Tues-
day 18 ghatis, Wednesday 14 ghatis, Thursday 10 ghatis, Friday
6 ghatis and Saturday 2 ghatis. All calculations are from sun-rise.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
(B) For night birth: From Sunday onwards respectively at 10,
6, 2, 26, 22, 18 and 14 from sun-set.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: Gulika Kala is interpreted as Gulika in Lagna obviously.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Like Rahu Kala, there is Gulika Kala also which may also,
however, fit in this context.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: If all the planets are in fall in Rasi and Navamsa or if they are

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
exalted in houses not happening to be the 9th/10th, the native
will only get his food by begging.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The fall of one time of all the planets in rasi is not
possible. Out of the 7, maximum 6 planets can be in fall. How-
ever, all can occupy neecha navamsas. The author allows the fall
to take place both in rasi and navamsas. Similarly, all planets (i.e.
leaving the nodes of course) cannot be again in exaltation in rasi.
Here also, additionally navamsa should be considered. The exal-
tation should essentially be in 9th or 10th for one planet at least
so that the Bhikshasana yoga does materealize.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
When the Ascendant lord is in the 12th, a malefic placed in
the 10th and the Moon is with Mars, Abhi yoga is formed

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
which makes one wander in distant places and suffer from
penury.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sun and the Moon be in the 9th, the Lagna or the
5th while Jupiter is in the 3rd house or in a Kendra, one born thus
will become mad. In such a yoga, essentially, the Kala Hora TTTF

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: at birth shall be that of Saturn or Mars.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: A day of 60 ghatis is divided into 24 horas, each of IVt
ghatis or one hour. The first hora after sun-rise is ruled by the
planet after whom the day is named. That is, on Thursday, the
first hora will be that of Jupiter; on Saturday, first hora is Saturn's
and so on. The next hora is ruled by the lord of the sixth day from
the first one. That is, the 2nd hora of Thursday is that of Mars.
Similarly the 3rd hora is ruled by the lord of the sixth day
counted from the 2nd hora lord. And the counting goes on in the
same way.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: Should the Moon and Mercury join in an angle, without the

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
aspect or company of another planet Paisacha ('Wfa) yoga is
produced. Such person will be mad.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Venus and the Moon are in an angle, while malefics are in
either the 8th or the 5th, Maha Gada yoga l 1 !?! ^KT) is produced.
This results in insanity.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: This sloka is only a repetition of Sloka 10 above.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Ascendant is occupied by Mars and Saturn, while its
lord is in the 2nd or the 8th along with the Moon and Mercury
and Venus are in a Kendra, even a person bom in superior caste
becomes a base man (i.e. he will not shine in life.)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars and Saturn be in an angle, Rahu in the Lagna
while benefics are in the 12th or the 6th, Chandala yoga is
formed. This yoga will make one shun the duties prescribed for
the family he succeeds.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Mercury, Venus and the Moon are relegated to angles
while Rahu is rising again Chandala yoga is produced. The per-
son who has such yoga will take to mean acts.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Epilepsy is caused to one bom in Parivesha kala, who has
simultaneously Saturn and Mars in the 6th or the 8th with Jupiter

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Saturn and Mars be in the ascendant while the lord
thereof is in the 2nd, the 8th or the 9th with benefics not being
angular, one will suffer from diseases throughout his life.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon, Saturn and Venus be in angles while the
Sun and Mars are in the 12th and the 8th, another kind of
Kemadruma yoga is produced. Such native will confine to his
birth place only, (for his livelihood).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If malefics are in 6th, 8th or 12th house, one is ousted from
his caste. Same is the result when these planets are in the 10th
and 2nd while auspicious rasis are not occupied by benefics.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the lord of the 9th be posited in the 12th while the
lords of the Moon sign and Lagna are with malefics and combust
in the Sun, the person will damage the fame of his dynasty and
will lose his wife and sons.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
When angles are occupied by malefics and benefics and the
Moon is aspected by Lagna Lord or alternatively in Saturn’s
Amsa, there is formation of Kulapamsana yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: The native who has Kulapamsana yoga will be deserted by

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
his family members, will face accute penury, live in foreign coun-
tries, lose his wife and sons, and suffer blemishes galore.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the lord of the 9th house is in the 2nd or in the 5th along
with the Sim, unaspected by benefics while the 3rd and 6th
are occupied by malefics, one will take to mean professions or
acts.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon be in a house of Saturn, while Saturn is in
an angle and Jupiter is in the 12th, the person resorts to begging
as profession.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The latter two positions may be counted either from
the Moon or the Lagna.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The position referred in the sloka can be for example thus:
Moon in the Aquarius, Saturn in Leo and Jupiter in Capricorn in
fall.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If there are malefic planets in the 8th, the 6th and the 12th
counted from the rasi occupied by Lagna Lord, one will leave his
native place. If such houses as reckoned from the rasi occupied
by the Lord of the Moon sign while the 9th is unoccupied by its
own lord, one will leave his native place by selling away his
possessions and because of blemishes of his own.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mercury, Jupiter (Moon) and Venus be in their inimi-
cal houses or in fall in rasi/amsa, while Saturn is in the Ascen-
dant, one will suffer on account of blemishes of the family (i.e. his
ancestors) and be deprived of wife and sons. The same results
can be indicated by 8th house also.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: As per the second principle, the said benefics should
be in the 8th rasi/amsa which are inimical. These can be in the
8th rasi but different navamsa in fall differently. For example, for
Dhanur lagna, these 3 planets can be in the 8th in Capcer, at the
same time Venus in Virgo navamsa, Jupiter in Capricorn
navamsa and Mercury in Pisces navamsa, aH in debilitation,
while Saturn can possibly rise in Sagittarius.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The Sun singly in deep fall can nullify the good effects in the
horoscope, though the other planets may well be in their own,
Moolatrikona and exaltation hosues.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: We give below various other Jataka Bhanga yogas,
which are capable of counter-acting Raja yogas:

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: (1) Moon in fall in 4th for Leo Lagna

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: (2) Mars in 28° of Cancer when Cancer rises.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: (3) Mercury in 15° Pisces for Virgo Lagna.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: (5) Venus in 27° in Virgo for Taurus.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: (6) Saturn in 20° of Aries for Pisces.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
(7) Lords of 9th, 10th and 11th in fall simultaneously. (This
is not possible for Sagittarius Lagna, Virgo lagna, Capri-
corn Lagna, and Leo Lagna.)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
(8) If four planets are in inimical houses or Neecha
Navamsas, Rajayogas are defunct.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: (9) Moon or Lagna not aspected by any planet.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: (10) The 10th house without any occupation or aspect.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
(12) Benefics combust and non-angular and Rahu in Lagna
receiving Moon’s aspect while malefics are in 3, 6 and 11.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sun be in Libra Navamsa, inspite of his being in
exaltation in rasi, even an emperor's son will be jettisoned down

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The Sun in Bharani 3rd quarter will cause such a
yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
According to Jataka parijata, the Sun as above should be
aspected by malefics. The condition of aspect by malefics is not
laid down by Horasara.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sun's position be in Libra 10 degrees, even 1000
Rajayogas are cancelled.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Venus be in Virgo navauisa, even an unparallel em-
pire will decline.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native, though belonging to a royal family if born at the
fall of a meteor, in Vyatipata, during a roaring thunder, or at tire
sight of comet will live on alms.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: Notes: See Jataka Tatwa, principle No. 190.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Lagna fall in Mercury’s decanate and be aspected
by the Moon from an angle, even a person born in royal
family will become artisan without any doubt, as declared by
the sages.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Venus be in fall or in a navamsa of Saturn and
aspected by Saturn while the Moon and the $un are in the 7th
from Lagna, the native along with his mother serves others.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Jataka Parijata, ch. 6 slokal3 also describes the above
yoga.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Moon is in the navamsa of the Sun and Vice Versa
while both of them are in one rasi, the native will have an
emaciated body.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The exchange of navamsas between the Sun and
Moon lets down all the Rajayogas in the horosocope and the
native suffers great poverty.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
According to the Sun, the Moon, Mars and Saturn occupying
in their order the 8th, 6th, the 2nd and the 12th, loss of eye sight
should be predicted through the strongest of the planets, i.e.
defect concerning such planet's humour will cause loss of eye
sight.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should malefics be in 9th, 11th, 3rd and 5th unaspected by
benefics damage of hearing should be forecast. One’s teeth will
present unsightly look, if these planets are in the 7th (and not
aspected by benefics).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The person will be insane if Saturn is in Lagna while Mars is
in the 7th, the 5th or the 9th and Moon is decreasing. The same
results will occur if the Sun is in the 12th from the Moon.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the 4th and the 8th houses from Venus be occupied
by malefics,j without being aspected by or conjoined with

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
benefics, death of the native's wife shall take place by fire, con-
finement, poison etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should be Venus placed in the midst of two bad planets, be
weak and in inimical or neecha amsa, the native's wife will die
for the reasons stated earlier, (i.e. as in sloka 37).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Venus is weak and is with the Sun in a trine while the
1st and 7th are occupied (by some planets), the natives will
have a disabled wife, will be sorrowful and addicted to others’
wives.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Saturn is in the ascendant, while the Moon and Venus are
in the setting house, i.e. the 7th house, one will have a barren
wife. Should the 1st, the 12th and 8th be occupied by malefics,
while the Moon is in the 5th house, the native will not have any
children.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
When the lord of the 7th is in the 5th, the native's wife is
destroyed and he will lose his children. Should malefics be in the
ascendant, the 5th, the 8th and the 12th, one's family is de-
stroyed.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mercury and Venus be in the 7th house while the
4th house is occupied by a malefic planet and the Moon has
another malefic in her 8th the dynasty of the native is destroyed.
Even Jupiter in the 4th house cannot save one in such a circum-
stance.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the lord of the 8th house occupy the 5th, while Lagna
has a malefic planet in it and the 4th has Moon therein, with the
5th lord being weak, there will be no descendancy after the
native.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: In addition to the 5th lord being weak, the following
three conditions should prevail: The lord of the 8th in the 5th, a
malefic in Lagna and the Moon in the 4th house.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the 12th house be occupied by weak Moon or weak
Sun, one will be one-eyed. In case the Sun is in the 7th or the 8th
house, along with a malefic, there will be eye diseases and tooth
decay.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the 4th and the 5th contain malefics, Jupiter posited in
the 12th while the Moon is in the 6th or the 8th without the
aspect or company of benefics, the native will doubtlessly
become blind.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon be on the meridian i.e. on the cusp of the
10th house. Mars be in the 7th house while Saturn is in the 2nd
from the Sun, the native will be disabled and be removed from
his caste. (He may change his religion also.)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native will incur leprosy if the Moon is in the navamsa of
Sagittraius, Capricorn or Pisces. Similar results will have to be
expected if the Lagna navamsa falls in Scorpio, Cancer, Aries or
Taurus and be in the company of a malefic.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The native will be affected as far as his private parts are
concerned if the Moon being in the company of aTnalefic, falls in
Cancer or Scorpio navamsa. Should the Moon be in the 4th
navamsa and be conjoined with a malefic planet, there will be
affliction to the native's chest, belly and ears.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Moon is shadowed by Rahu and be in the 12th along
with a malefic, the native will become insane, tend to quarrel or
be irritated.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Note: The combination is that of Moon, Rahu and another
malefic in the 12th from Lagna.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Saturn, posited in an angle with strength, aspect the
lord of the Moon sign, the person will be disabled, unlucky and
become an ascetic.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the four planets, namely: Mars, the Sun, Jupiter and Saturn
be together, avoiding the ascendant, the 4th, the 7th the 10th, the
5th and 9th (i.e. join in the 2nd, the 3rd, the 6th, the 8th, the 11th
or thel2th) the native will be instrumental for the destruction of
his dynasty, will be devoid of wife, sons and money and live in
foreign countries.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should one among Jupiter, the Moon and the Sun be in
the Lagna or the 10th while a malefic is in the 12th even
with ordinary brilliance and be aspected by an exceed-
ingly strong Saturn, the native will lead men and obtain a holy
order.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The aspect of Saturn should be on the planet in the
Lagna or the 10th while a malefic is in the 12th even with ordi-
nary brilliance and be aspected by an exceedingly strong Saturn,
the native will lead men and obtain a holy order.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The aspect of Saturn should be on the planet in the
Lagna or the 10th house, so that the holy order sustains.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon be in a benefic's rasi or amsa (of Mercury
in particular) and be in aspect to Saturn, who is with
strength, and going towards the meredian in own house or in
exaltation house, the native will become a Sanyasi and be not
happy.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: For example, a Capricorn native with Moon in the
12th in the house of Jupiter and aspected by a strong Saturn
posited in the 10th cusp in Libra will take to ascetism.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
When the Moon is waxing and is with exemplary strength
and the ascendant lord in aspect to Mars who is devoid of
strength, the native will take to penance, will be grief-stricken, be
devoid of wealth and followers and will obtain his food and
drink with difficulty.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The strength of the waxing Moon is with reference to
her varga bala etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the lord of the ascendant join the Sun and aspect the
Moon while Lagna is occupied by Venus or Jupiter and aspected
by a malefic, the native causes destruction to the nobility of his
birth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: This combination should be interpreted with caution.
The malefic planet aspecting Venus or Jupiter in Lagna should be
exceedingly strong, stronger than the aspected and simulta-
neously deadly inimical to the sign rising on the horizon. In such
case, the native resorts to ignoble means.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Venus be in depression or inimical rasi and amsa, a
malefic planet in a trine and the Lagna without good aspect, the
native will give up his domestic responsibilities, be sagely in
disposition and throughout life will follow others in the matter of
principles (i.e. will not have any of his own).

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The several yogas enumerated as above should be carefully
evaluated along with the planets’ strengths and weakness so that
the good or bad of the Dasa periods are rightly declared.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: ffrT <jTl 1 * hif(? J qro l M ^ y 11 Pa f

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Thus ends the 24th Chapter entitled "Adverse
combinations for a nativity" in Horasara of
Prithuyasas, son of Varaha Mihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The effects of various combinations and Dasas should be
equally applied to both females and males. The effects applicable
to women as denoted by their horoscopes shall be restricted to
them alone if those are of such nature. The rest shall be applicable
to their husbands.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The general rules of Raja yogas and Ava yogas, lon-
gevity, Dasa Bhuktis are equally similar for both men and
women. Some rules like menstruation, carrying a child in the
womb, chastity of mind and physique (hRisui) and such others as
peculiar to women shall be restricted to the fair sex only. The
other common results like livelihood etc. may be interpreted for
men from their wives' natal charts.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The female's widowhood should be deduced from the 8th
house. Her husband's luck and happiness are noted from her 7th
house. Her appearance is indicated by her Lagna. Her children
and wealth depend on her 9th house.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Of the Moon and Lagna, whichever is stronger,
should be based for predictive purposes. A female's beauty,
chastity, etc. are deduced from Lagna or Moon. Some say that
9th house indicates good or bad of the husband.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Benefic planets which are strong will produce auspicious
results if they are connected with the said houses. Malefics give
bad effects in such cases. The Bhavas that are not occupied by
their lords should be evaluated in such a manner.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should both of the Lagna and the Moon fall in masculine
rasis and masculine amsas, and join malefics, she will have a
male's appearance, be unbecoming and unfit for her husband.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should both the Lagna and the Moon be in even rasi/amsa
(i.e. female signs and amsas), the girl will possess-a true feminine
disposition. If benefics lend their aspects, or join Lagna/Moon as
above, she will be lucky, chaste and famous.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Trimsamsa effects should be declared with reference to the
stronger of the Moon and Lagna. The lord of such trimsamsa
should also be strong.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The trimsamsas in odd signs are ruled as under:
Mars 5, Saturn 5, Jupiter 8, Mercury 7 and Venus 5. In case of an
even sign: Venus 5, Mercury 7, Jupiter 8, Saturn 5 and Mars 5.
The 30 degree portion is alloted in the above proportion and
order.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The female born in a sign of Mars and in the trimsamsa of
Mars will give birth to a dead child and will not be of good
qualities. Should the trimsamsa be that of Mercury (in Aries and
Scorpio), she will be cunning, will follow dirty principles and

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the trimsamsa (in Aries or Scorpio) at birth be that of
Jupiter, she will beget offspring, burdened by expenses galore
and be dear to her partner. Should the said trimsamsa be of
Venus, she will beget daughters and will indulge in secret
(unsanctioned) sexual pleasures.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Being an Arien or Scorpion if born in a trimsamsa of Saturn,
the female will be a servant and be vicious in several ways. The
position of the Sun in trimsamsa in similar manner may also
yield similar results.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Apart from considering the Lagna and the Moon for
trimsamsa position, the Sun in the various trimsamsas can also
yield similar results. This is what is hinted at in the last line of
this sloka.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the birth in a sign of Mercury fall in Mars trimsamsa
area, the female will be addicted to another man. She will have
few issues. And in Mercury's trimsamsa she will be supreme of
the family and if in the trimsamsa of Venus, she will have cattle,
wealth and luxuries.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
In the trimsamsa of Jupiter, a female born in a Mercury's sign
will be devoted to her husband exclusively, be dear to him.
If Jupiter is in own house or in exaltation sign, same effects
will prevail. If she is bom in a Mercury's sign, in Saturn's
trimsamsa, she will equal a neuter, will give birth to dead
child (or her children will die) and she will not live with her
husband.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If a sign of Jupiter rules at birth, the female born in the
trimsamsa of Mars, will be a domestic servant, and will be
famous, if in the trimsamsa of Jupiter, she will be very rich and in
Mercury's trimsamsa, she will be adored by all. She will have
sons if the trimsamsa be of Venus. She will also be virtuous and
dear to her husband. The trimsamsa of Saturn will make her
poor, beget daughters and independent at all times.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
For birth in a sign of Venus in the trimsamsa of Mars: she
will be wicked, like quarrels, hate her husband, and will have a
bad history. If the trimsamsa is that of Mercury, she will take
pleasure in poetry, arts, singing and playing instruments, will be
beautiful and virtuous. She will be bestowed with husband, sons
and wealth, if the trimsamsa is that of Jupiter. Should the
trimsamsa belong to Venus, she will have all luxuries, be sharp
and dear to all. If the birth is in Saturn's trimsamsa, she wifi
remarry. She will beget dead children or lose children and be
always sick.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Now a sign of Saturn at birth. Should the trimsamsa belong
to Mars, she will be a servant, an unchaste woman and will beget
dead children. Mercury's trimsamsa indicates that she will not

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
be loyal to her husband, be unchaste and cunning. She will be
dear to her husband, lucky and widely famous, if born in
Jupiter's trimsamsa. If bom in the trimsamsa of Venus, she will
be of lordly disposition, be barren and be devoid of good history.
She will take to bad traditions and will be very unlucky if bom in
Saturn's trimsamsa.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
As regards those females born in Leo: In trimsamsa of
Mars-she will be very talkative, unchaste, be in distant places,
and will resemble men in appearance and qualities. In the
trimsamsa of Mercury, she will be devoted of her work but be
not chaste. She will be dear to king, will not have many issues
and be always sick if bom in trimsamsa of Venus. She will be
healthy and poor if Saturn is the ruler of trimsamsa. She will be
liked by the king if bom in Jupiter's trimsamsa.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Now the various trimsamsa in Cancer at birth: She will be
self-willed, sensual and will lose children if the trimsamsa is that
of Mars. The issues and longevity are limited by Jupiter's
trimsamsa. Mercury's trimsamsa will make her an artisan. She
will be either barren or have children dead if it is Venusian
trimsamsa. Saturn's trimsamsa will deprive of her husband and
she will take out her food with difficulty.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The astrologer should predict the effects of trimsamsa as
detailed above. Such trimsamsa effects should be predicted

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
through the Moon and the Sun or through the Lagna and the
Moon.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Out of the Moon, Lagna and the Sun, whichever is
stronger, will yield results depending on the trimsamsa occu-
pied.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
One's husband will be wretched if the 7th house is vacant, be
weak if aspected by malefics, but not benefics.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mercury and Saturn be in the 7th house, she will
beget a husband equal to a neuter. She will be barren and un-
lucky. She will always be away. Should the 7th be a movable rasi
or its lord be in such navamsa, her husband will like to be away
from home and a fixed sign will make him stick to home.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sun be in he 7th, she will be given up by her
husband. Early widowhood is caused by Mars in the 7th. If
Saturn is in the 7th and aspected by malefics, she will remain
unmarried or she will become a widow and go to other men.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Another marriage to a woman is indicated if the 7th house is
occupied by both malefics and benefics. She will become a
widow if both Mars and Saturn are in the 7th house owned by
malefic.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sun and Rahu be in the 7th house, the lady will
have many husbands. If a malefic is in the 7th house without
strength and benefic aspect, she will be given up by her husband
and if the said planet be also in depression, she will be inimical to
her husband.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should there be exchange of navamsas between Mars and
Venus, the female will be secretly addicted to other men. If she
has the Moon in her 7th house simultaneously, her husband also
will be so.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Moon and Venus be together in Lagna, belonging to
Mars or Saturn, while the 5th house is occupied by a malefic, the
woman in question will be barren.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Mars aspected by Saturn is in the 7th rasi or navamsa or
Saturn aspected by Mars is similarly posited, the female will
have diseased vagina. She will also be unfortunate.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the 7th house be owned and aspected by a benefic
and similarly the 7th navamsa, the female will belong to a su-
premely classified lot and dear to her husband without any
doubt.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The writers on erotical science divided the women
into 4 classes. According to Rathi Manjari, they are: Padmini,

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Padmagandha, Charukesi and Krisangi. The first two kinds of
women possess soft speech, virtues, and be interested in songs
and dances. The other two kinds of females are said to possess
eyes like the petals of lotus, narrow and sharp nostrils, and big
and elevated pair of breast.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The lady who has a good 7th house will belong to one such
supreme classifications.

text:
If the Sun is in own house in the 7th rasi/amsa, the husband
of such a lady will be sensually disposed and soft in speech. The
Moon in similar condition indicates a soft spoken husband who
will be at the disposal of another lady. Mars in such a case gives
a poor husband who is addicted to other women. Mercury in
similar position gives a learned and happy husband. A virtuous
husband who has five sense under control is indicated by Jupiter.
The female gets a lucky and happy husband who has Venus in
similar position. Saturn disposed thus gives an old man and a
dunce as husband, Thus should be guessed about the husband of
the female who has these planets in the 7th.

text:
Whatever has been said about tire 7th house and the Lagna
should be combined with the various combinations in the horo-
scopes of the couple and results declared accordingly.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas

text:
and occupied by the Moon and Venus, the female will be happy
but will hate her husband. She will always be on the move.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon, and Mercury be in the ascendant, she will
be a supreme person of the race, and will be an exponent of
Vedas. If Venus and Mercury be in the Lagna, she will be lucky
and a supreme person of the race. Should Mercury, the Moon
and Venus be in the Lagna, the female will have abundant com-
forts and money. Jupiter in the Lagna gives her exceeding
wealth, prosperity and sons.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should a planet in Lagna be in own house or in exaltation
will prove auspicious, though it be malefic in nature.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: According to this sloka, Saturn in Capricorn,
Aquarius or Libra as Ascendants is good. Similarly other
planets.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should a malefic be in the 8th, widowhood is caused. An
aspect from another malefic thereto makes it all the more certain.
The dasa of the lord of the navamsa occupied by the lord of the
8th house will surely bring forth widowhood to a female.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If a benefic planet is in the 8th house, the woman predeceases
her husband. Both the husband and wife quit the world at a time,
if the female has both benefic and malefic in the 8th house. The
strength and weakness of the planets should be wisely under-
stood.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Though there be malefics in the 7th or the 8th, a benefic in the
9th in a female's nativity will give her happiness concerning her
husband and issues. She will along with her husband have a long
lease of life.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Sagittarius, Cancer or Pisces rise at the birth, the
female will be source of misery to her husband and issues.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Moon is in the 5th house identical with Leo, Scorpio,
Taurus or Virgo, the female will have not many issues. This is
equally true in regard to males also.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Malefics posited in the Lagna, the 7th, the 8th and the 9th
will give only bad results. Should these houses be devoid of
benefics, the female will always be subjected to grievous effects.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should a malefic be in the 4th, the female will deliver many
times. At the time of giving a girl away in marriage, whatever
ways have been laid earlier, should be consulted.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: A malefic in the 4th will only cause frequent deliver-
ies for the female. How long the children live will depend on the
9th house.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Thus ends the 25th Chapter entitled "Stree Jataka" in
Horasara of Prithuyasas, son of Varaha Mihira

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
AH the creatures will face death for some reason or other. To
decide the reasons, the several indications are to be known thus:

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Note the planet occupying the 8th house. If it is the Sun, the
death is through fire; the Moon-water, Mars-weapon, Mercury-
fall, Jupiter-fever, Venus-indigestion and Saturn-hunger. De-
pending on the 8th house being a movable, fixed or dual sign,
death will be in foreign, own house or while on the move.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The death of a native will be due to so many afflictions as the
planets are many in the 8th house. The planets in the 8th house
from the stronger of Lagna and the Moon are to be considered
(for purpose of death.)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The death of a native may be expected through the humour
(wind, phlegm or bile) belonging to the 8th house or the navamsa
occupied by the 8th lord.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the rasi or navamsa referred to above is Aries, death
will be caused by fever, poison, defects of digestive fire and bile.
The humour causing death will be according to the planet joining
or aspecting.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should such a rasi/navamsa be the Taurus death will be due
to the three humours, weapons, thirst etc. This is so when the
rasi/navamsa above is not occupied by any planet. If occupied,
the humour of the planet concerned will prevail.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should it be Gemini rasi or navamsa, death v. ,; ll be due to
cough, breathing troubles, diseases generated by heat, colics etc.
Tire rasi or the navamsa of the Moon indicates death due to
rheumatic pains, mental affliction, diarrhoea etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the rasi or navamsa be Leo, death will be through
tumour, poison, weapon etc., or fever. Virgo in such case will
cause death through defect in digestive fire or private parts*
disputes or fall.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should it be Libra death will be through the blunders com-
mitted by his thoughts, fever, delirium or the effects of the dasa
ruling at that time.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: Should it be Scorpio, death will be due to jaundice, and

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
defective spleen etc. Should it be Sagittarius having a malefic
therein, death will be through a tree, water, weapon, wood etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If it is Makara rasi or navamsa, death is due to hit by spear or
while tilling lands or by mental aberration. Should it be con-
joined with a malefic death is through wild animals like tiger,
fever, cough, consumption (pulmonary disease) and in unnatural
circumstances i.e. man-made.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should it be Aquarius rasi or navamsa and be with malefic
death will be through tigers, weapons, snakes etc., and cough,
fever, consumption etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should it be Pisces rasi or amsa, death will be due to snakes,
journey, wind, machinery, collition of a steamer in the mid-
waters or through the roaring thunders.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Death should normally happen due to dysentry, fever, thirst,
diseases of stomach, poison, lack of continued food, breakage,
and diseases in the body.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon be in her fateful degrees as mentioned
before identical with Lagna, 12th or 8th, death should be ex-
pected through water, machinery etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Moon and the Sun be in Lagna in a common sign (i.e.
Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius or Pisces) and be conjoined with or
aspected by a malefic planet, the native's life ends surely in the
midst of water.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Nates: Suppose Pisces rises with the Sun and the Moon along
with Rahu, there may be danger through water, like drowning,
being washed away in floods, death in torrential rains etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Saturn is in the 4th while the Moon is in the 7th and Mars
in the 10th, death will take place by falling down from a tree or in
a well.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Moon is in the Aries, Scorpio, Capricorn or Aquarius,
between two malefics and without any aspect from benefics,
death will be by ropes, thunderbolt, weapons, etc. Same result
follows if the Moon is in Virgo.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should malefics be in the 4th and 10th and benefics in the 8th
or the Lagna, death will be by implement through a spear or
trident or by rheumatic, heart cardiac arrest etc. (SWJd)

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: Since malefics are involved in the 4th, diseases like
rheumatic, heart cardiac arrest etc. are indicated.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Saturn be in 12th, 6th, 8th, or the 4th along with the
Moon, the native's end occurs in the sea. Two malefics surround-
ing the 8th may also bring about such a death.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If there are malefics in the trines from Lagna or the Moon or
if Rahu is in the 8th, death will be caused by hanging.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Sun and Rahu are in the ascendant while the Moon is in
the 6th/8th and malefics be in the 12th, death will take place
through poison or weapon.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Rahu is placed in the 4th or the 8th and is aspected by the
Lord of the 8th, or if the 8th is occupied by malefic or aspected by
such a planet, death is indicated by poison, weapon or fire.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Death by hanging is indicated if the Sun is in the 7th house
along with Rahu or Ketu while Venus is in the 8th.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Lagna lord be in an angle and surrounded by two
malefics while the 8th is tenanted by a planet, death is caused by
one's own anger.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If the Sun is in Lagna while Saturn is in the 5th house and
Mars in the 2nd or the 9th the native's death is caused by a tree,
thunderbolt or a wall.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Death by fall of a log is indicated if decreasing Moon is in
the 8th house, the Sun is in the 4th, Saturn in the 7th, Mars in
the 2nd.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If decreasing Moon is in the 10th house, while Mars is in the
9th, Saturn ascending and the Sun in the 5 th, death will be by fire
or remaining in bondage.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text: p^i Tftft farenit TOT ll 29 II

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars be in Libra while the Sun is in Aries/Scorpio
and the Moon in one of the rasis of Mars or Saturn, death will
take place amidst filth.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The death of the native will be through royal displeasure or
one's own weapons if Mars is in the 4th, the Sun in the 7th,
Saturn in the 10th while 8th has some planet in it.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Saturn is in the 2nd or 4th, while the Moon is in the 10th
and Mars in the 7th, death of the native will be caused by worms.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the 4th and 10th contain malefics while the decreas-
ing Moon is in the 8th, 12th or the 6th, the native's end will occur
while he is on journey or through a thunderbolt.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Sun and Mars be in the 12th the Moon and Rahu
in the 7th, and Jupiter in angle the native will die in a distant
place or in a temple or garden.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the lord of the 8th be in the 8th, identical with a
watery sign or in the 6th, or 12th, the native's death will be
through cruel animals, snakes or falling in a well or while in his
own abode.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
If Ketu is in the 8th house, while the 8th lord is in an angle,
malefics in the 12th and the Lagna Lord be devoid of strength,
the native's death will be due to his resorting to bad ways.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas

text:
Should the Lagna be in Visha Ghatika Muhurta while the 8th
house has a malefic in it, the death will be through poison, fire or
weapon. The same results can be expected if the 8th Lord is
fateful in degree joining a malefic.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should Mars and Saturn exchange their rasis or navamsas,
be in fateful degrees (of those signs occupied by them) and be
angular (form Lagna), the native's death will be through sover-
eign wrath or by being impaled by a spear or some such killing
weapons.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The exchange of Saturn and Mars can only be (1)
Aquarius-Scorpio or (2) Capricom-Aries so that they can be in
Lagna's angle.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Moon be in Lagna, the Sun in the 8th without
strength, Jupiter in the 12th while a malefic is in the 4th house.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
the native's death will take place following the removal of his
hands and eyes or through weapons by meain elements at night.

text:
If Mars and Mercury be in the 8th house while the Lagna
Lord is in the rasi or amsa of a benefic planet, the native's death
takes place through flies, venomous reptiles etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should there be many planets in the 4th house while the 8th
lord and ascendant lord are together, the death of the native will
come to pass along with many persons.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: This combination may be found in such cases of
earth-quakes, air/rail accidents which are major in nature, food
poison in public places etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the Lagna lord be in the company of 5th and 8th lords
in any rasi, the native will die along with his son. If it is a
combination of Lagna lord, 7th and 8th lords, the native dies
along with his wife.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Naturally, if a dasa is at its end, the death will occur in
simple way (i.e. not by cruel or painful means) and the mid of an
untoward planet's dasa the death will be cruel corresponding to
the 8th house.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The place of death will correspond to the rasi or navamsa of
the 8th lord. According to rasi and amsa the place, whether on
land or in water, and the direction of death should be guessed.

text:
If the Lagna is a sign which is strong in nights, death will
come to pass in a night. And day-signs at birth will bring about
the end in day time. If the Lagna is vacant, these results will come
to pass. If, however, there be a planet, the effects relating to that
planet shall also be weighed.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
The state of unconsciousness preceding one’s death will cor-
respond to the navamsas elapsed (i.e. the period in terms of
navamsas passed in particular natal lagna), if when a benefic is in
the lagna. If the 8th lord is in his own or exaltation rasi or
navamsa, it has to be trebled.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: The person will be unconscious depending on the
reasons for death for a period equal to the time elapsed at birth
in Lagna. If, for example, one is born in Virgo in which 45
minutes have passed, he will be without consciousness for an
equal duration. If the 8th lord is in own rasi or exaltation rasi,
this period is multiplied by 3. And if it be so in both rasi and
amsa charts, the duration will be six-fold.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
When the Ascendant lord is in a watery navamsa or watery
sign, the Moon or Venus aspecting tire 4th house and the 8th and
the 12th be occupied by malefics, the native will be killed in the
middle of water, i.e. mid-river etc.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Should the lord of the Lagna be in the 8th in navamsa or be
combust or even in an enemy’s rasi, one will die in a country
where he has no relatives and in a natural course.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Note the lord of navamsa occupied by Lagna lord. If the said
navamsa lord be in Lagna in rasi kundali along with the Lagna
lord or aspected by Lagna lord death will occur in a place other
than the one of birth. The lagna and its Lord can also be replaced
with the Moon sign lord in the said combination.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

text:
Notes: There are two combinations suggested in the sloka.
Assume Lagna is Taurus and its lord Venus is in the Scorpio
navamsa. If Mars ruling the said amsa be in Taurus, which is the
rasi lagna and be with Venus or be aspected by Venus, the results
mentioned will come to pass. Similarly, assume the Moon is in
Sagittarius rasi, and its lord Jupiter is in Mercury's navamsa i.e.
Virgo or Gemini. Now if the said Mercury is in Sagittarius,
joining Jupiter or aspected by him can bring about identical
event. Another possible interpretation for the 2nd line is that the
lagna lord should aspect the navamsa lord of the Moon sign lord
to which, however, 1 do not subscribe.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
metadata.notes: Written by the son of Varahamihira.

metadata.author: Prithuyashas
